scope.purpose: Let the user turn one option on or off, independently of other options, in a choice that is confirmed later (form submission) or that selects items.
useCases: An independent option in a form (subscribe to the newsletter).
A required acceptance (terms) inside Field with an error message.
A row selector in a table with hideLabel, and a select-all checkbox with the indeterminate state.
A list of independent options, each with a description.
exclusions: A grouped list with a group label and group validation (CheckboxGroup): later; until then, stack Checkboxes under a heading.
alternatives: RadioGroup for one choice among several.

decisionsTaken: One derived state axis `condition` keys the field and choice color families (color.field.{condition}.*, color.choice.{selection}.{condition}.*), resolved from the disabled, readonly and invalid props and pointer hover with a fixed precedence (disabled, readonly, invalid, [focus,] hover, default). The props stay separate (contract-guide: validation is not an interaction state); only the token lookup is flattened, as the approved field family already is.
Controls perform no validation and expose invalid/required only; the visible error message and required marker belong to Field (catalog composition rule: controls are standalone, Field wraps them).

New semantic family color.choice.{off,on}.{default,hover,readonly,disabled,invalid}.{surface,content,border} shared by Checkbox, Radio and Switch (foundation change, listed at the gate). off aliases the field family (surface, border; content = the field placeholder color, used as the off switch thumb). on: accent fill with a contrasting mark (light accent.600/700 with white; dark accent.400/300 with neutral.900 so that the fill reaches 3:1 on dark surfaces), readonly and disabled alias the field family (no fill, dark or grey mark), invalid fills with color.field.invalid.border.

New sizes size.choice.{sm,md,lg} = 14, 16, 20 px (common axis: like icons, they do not shrink with density); box radius radius.indicator; gap space.control.gap.{size}; label typography.body.{size}; description typography.body.sm in color.content.secondary.
The box is centered on the first line of the label; label and description wrap.
Indeterminate is a bindable prop; activation from indeterminate checks the box (the common select-all behavior).
Readonly is supported (focusable, announced read-only, ignores activation) because the approved field family has a readonly condition and forms show readonly values.
The focus ring surrounds the box only, with corners of radius plus focus.offset (concentric, computed; no new token).
The mark uses the Phosphor bold weight (check, minus) drawn at the box size: the regular weight is 1 px thin in a 16 px box.
Colors are chosen in two levels: each condition sets the off and on sets, then the selection picks one (equal-specificity condition selectors, source order is the precedence).
